outline: A brief introduction of general chemistry and chemical reactions, covering atomic structure and bonding, quantitative chemistry, gas, thermodynamics, kinetics, etc. In addition to the basic principles of chemistry, this course will focus on letting students understand the relationship between chemistry and daily life.
schedule:
Week/Topic
1    Chemistry and Measurement
2    Atoms, Molecules, and Ions
3    Atoms, Molecules, and Ions
4    Calculations with Chemical Formulas and Equations
5    Calculations with Chemical Formulas and Equations
6    Chemical Reactions
7    Chemical Reactions
8    The Gaseous State
9    Midterm
10  Thermochemistry
11  Quantum Theory of the Atom
12  Quantum Theory of the Atom
13  Electron Configurations and Periodicity
14  Electron Configurations and Periodicity
15  Ionic and Covalent Bonding
16  Final
17  Flexible Learning/ Molecular Geometry and Chemical Bonding Theory
18  Flexible Learning/ Molecular Geometry and Chemical Bonding Theory
